text:
Maria P: Heads-up — we're hitting a p4dn spot crunch in us-central. latency-sensitive jobs are getting spilled and cost is creeping up. looking for quick procurement ideas. :grimacing:
Theo L: What mix are we on currently? price-optimized? capacity-optimized?
Maria P: Price-optimized with aggressive max_bid shading (30% of on-demand). worked well until the last two hours of the market cycle.
Asha R: Market spikiness this week — I'd vote for short windows of capacity-optimized in the busiest hours, then shift back to price-optimized off-peak.
Ben K: Agree. also: can we increase warm-buffer of reserved on-demand a touch to avoid cold-starts for latency-critical routes? small delta but big UX win.
Maria P: Proposed quick config: keep a 6-node soft-reserve (on-demand) per region, 30min warm TTL, and dynamic bid shading that relaxes to capacity-optimized when preemption rate > 5%. Thoughts?
Theo L: Love the soft-reserve idea. but how do we manage KV cache / model shards movement when we spill between spot pools and reservepool? migrating caches is the pain.
Asha R: We can do delta sync + background rebuild: on preemption signal, ship recent KV diffs to redis and trigger async rewarm. not instant but avoids full cold start.
Ben K: Also worth adding a prioritization policy for workloads: latency_critical -> reservepool, best_effort -> price-optimized. That minimises cost for background work.
Maria P: Here's a sketch of the fleet preference snippet I ran locally (pseudo-config):
```json
{
  "fleet_preferences": ["capacity_optimized","price_optimized","regional_spill"],
  "soft_reserve": {"type": "on_demand", "count": 6, "ttl_mins": 30},
  "preempt_threshold_pct": 5,
  "spill_policy": {"latency_critical": "reservepool", "batch": "price_optimized"}
}
```
Theo L: If we flip to capacity_optimized too often we'll pay more. idea: run a cheap market-sim for 10m windows and only switch when expected loss from preemptions outweighs extra cost.
Maria P: Good call. I ran a quick sim script against last 7 days of spot history — switching on >5% preempted tokens saved ~12% P50 latency tail at +8% cost. Will share numbers.
infra-bot: [simulation-run] 2143658700-sim-1 completed. summary: preempt_prob>0.05 => capacity_pref improves tail, cost_delta +7.8% avg.
Asha R: Can we be smarter with bid shading? e.g., variable shading: lower bids for non-critical file loads, raise to 60% for warm-buffer refill windows. avoids constant max bids.
Ben K: Also think about multicloud region tilt: if us-central is noisy, spill to us-west2 but tag jobs with region affinity so dataset egress is controlled.
Maria P: Yes — region affinity + cost cap. We should also enable a short-term regional throttle to avoid mass spill causing network saturation.
Theo L: Operational playbook: 1) detect preempt trend 2) run sim 3) if sim suggests, flip to capacity_optimized for 30m 4) increase soft_reserve by N 5) kick async rewarm. Need an operator checkbox and metric gated automation.
Asha R: For step 3 automation, add hysteresis and cooldown so we don't oscillate every 15m. + stabilize the warm-buffer TTL. :thumbsup:
Maria P: I'll prototype an automation runbook and a small lambda that toggles fleet_preferences and posts diffs. target: test in staging tomorrow at 09:00 UTC.
Ben K: If staging looks good, we can roll to canary region next week. Also update cost forecasts with +8% delta so finance isn't surprised.
Maria P: Filed a short RFC in #eng-infra for the runbook and sim output. tagging folks: @Theo L @Asha R @Ben K.
Theo L: I can own the sim and the metric gating.
Asha R: I'll sketch the KV delta sync flow and add a `rebuild_score` heuristic for rewarm ordering.
infra-bot: [note] scheduled test window set for 2143745100 (staging) by Maria P.
Maria P: Thanks team — will post results in this thread after the test. :pray:
